# Recordings of calls with real modems (format: tools/README.md), and what
# v90m-replay must make of each. Columns: file, v90m-replay options (the
# settings the call was made with), the expected "modulation ..." line of
# the replay up to the SNR, the modem, the date of the call.
#
# Each recording ends 10 to 20 ms after the modem connected: the handshake
# only, no user data. The transmit matches the recording up to the start of
# data mode (the recording modem's own data bits), except x2b: recorded
# before the fixes of 2026-11-16 for that modem, it is answered differently
# from 18.4 s on, and goes on to connect at V.34 as the modem does today.
# All were recorded before 0.7.0's V.34 transmit cap: -C replays them
# without it (with it our MP differs from the one sent, and the echo the
# recording holds no longer matches).
cxa.raw.xz   -C -9 -u 33600 modulation 7, 50666 bit/s down, 25333 up   Conexant CX93001 (USB), AT+PIG=0          2026-11-16
v34a.raw.xz  -C             modulation 5, 31200 bit/s down, 28800 up   Conexant CX93001 (USB), V.34 forced       2026-11-15
v21a.raw.xz  -C             modulation 1, 300 bit/s down, 300 up       Conexant CX93001 (USB), V.21 forced       2026-11-15
usr7.raw.xz  -C -9          modulation 7, 54666 bit/s down, 40000 up   U.S. Robotics 5686, firmware 5.4.62       2026-11-16
usr6.raw.xz  -C -9 -u 32000 modulation 7, 54666 bit/s down, 32000 up   U.S. Robotics 5686, firmware 5.4.62       2026-11-16
x2r2.raw.xz  -C -9 -u 33600 modulation 4, 54666 bit/s down, 28800 up   U.S. Robotics 56K of 1998, flash 5.1.4    2026-11-16
x2b.raw.xz   -C -9 -u 33600 modulation 5, 28800 bit/s down, 28800 up   U.S. Robotics 56K of 1998, flash 5.1.4    2026-11-16
